title: Brain Memory Entry
description: A single entry in the shared model-agnostic memory system (brain/). Stored as Markdown with YAML frontmatter. Readable and writable by any AI model.

id.description: Stable identifier — never rename after first use. Format: mem-<slug>

title.description: Human-readable title — used in index and context headers

type.description: concept=how something works | entity=facts about a thing | procedure=how to do something | episode=what happened | decision=why something was chosen

tags.description: Tag IDs from _data/tags.json — enables cross-system filtering

systems.description: System IDs from docs/08-governance/systems.yaml — mirrors what governed documents already carry, and answers 'everything about this subsystem' directly rather than through tags or brain/ folder structure.

source_model.description: Model or human that authored or last substantively edited this entry. Format: provider/model-id or 'human'. Examples: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6, openai/gpt-4o, google/gemini-2.0-flash, human

project.description: Project ID this memory belongs to, or null for global memories

confidence.description: How reliable this memory is. Uncertain = needs verification before acting on it.

scope.description: global=applies everywhere | project=scoped to one project | session=temporary, review for promotion to global
